Automerge non-major updates once the required checks pass; majors stay manual

Pins a custom manager reads are merged by hand. Upstream spec pins: Renovate cannot renew the sha256 of a spec file (docs/upstream-contracts.md). Workflow gate tools: a new version changes what a required check refuses, so a person reads its release notes
The two images of the workflow gate move in a pull request of their own
praetor-managed files: praetorctl adopt ships their updates and praetorctl audit locks them byte for byte

TypeScript 7 drops the JavaScript compiler API that @sveltejs/kit reads tsconfig through (svelte-kit sync fails with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'readFile')"), and @sveltejs/kit 3.1.0 declares the peer range typescript ^6.0.0. Revisit when a released @sveltejs/kit peer range admits typescript 7 (#149)

The upgrade test moves a database from the previous Postgres major to the current one (storetest.PreviousMajorImage, #252): that pin takes digest and minor updates but stays on major 17. Move it with the current major when Postgres 19 is adopted

The chart upgrade test moves a CloudNativePG cluster from the previous Postgres major to the current one (tools/e2e/cnpg_pg_upgrade.sh, #252): each operand pin takes digest and minor updates on its own major. Move both, with old_major and new_major, when Postgres 19 is adopted
See the rule above: the current-major operand pin of the chart upgrade test stays on 18
linuxserver keeps old Ubuntu-base tags 18.04.1 / 20.04.1 that read as majors (dashboard #55 proposed deluge v18, qbittorrent v20)

linuxserver/qbittorrent also keeps the 14.x tags of its 2022 libtorrent builds (14.3.9 = qBittorrent 4.3.9, pushed 2022-01-06), which read as a major above 5.x (#518 proposed v14). This rule replaces the one above for qbittorrent, so it repeats the Ubuntu-base exclusion
@playwright/test and the Playwright image of the visual baseline move together: tools/e2e/web_visual.sh refuses an image whose version differs from the lockfile
praetor-managed engine: updates arrive in one coordinated adoption pull request

The Postgres pins of the tests and CI move in one pull request: tools/ci/image_pin_check.py refuses one image tag pinned to two digests. It sets no automerge: a group branch automerges only when every update in it does, and the rule for custom manager pins keeps the storetest and end-to-end pins merged by hand

description: Media, *arr and own consumer apps take releases without the 3-day wait; infrastructure keeps its waits (fleet-rule-media-apps-no-release-wait-20261027). ffmpeg is a fixture tool rather than a media app and stays gated
Covers the ghcr.io/hotio and lscr.io/linuxserver pins, which Renovate 44.234.0 cannot date outside index.docker.io, alongside the Docker Hub deluge, qbittorrent and rtorrent-rutorrent pins
Renovate 44.234.0 dates Docker releases only on index.docker.io, so mirror.gcr.io pins never aged past the 3-day minimumReleaseAge (#1068)

mirror.gcr.io serves Docker Hub images under identical manifest digests (skopeo 1.25.1, 2026-11-11: aquasec/trivy:0.75.0, kindest/node:v1.37.0, moby/buildkit:v0.33.1, rhysd/actionlint:1.7.12, rustfs/rustfs:1.0.1 and tonistiigi/binfmt:qemu-v10.2.3 match Docker Hub; library/postgres:18-alpine is the same repository after the tag moved on Docker Hub)
Looking up the stripped Docker Hub twin keeps the 3-day release wait while tracked files keep the mirror.gcr.io host
ffmpeg is a test fixture tool rather than a consumer media app, so it keeps the 3-day minimumReleaseAge wait

lscr.io/linuxserver/ffmpeg:9.0.2-cli-ls86 carries the same manifest digest as docker.io/linuxserver/ffmpeg at the same tag (skopeo 1.25.1, 2026-11-11), so looking up linuxserver/ffmpeg dates it on Docker Hub

Exact-scoped images with no release timestamp source in Renovate 44.234.0 (its Docker datasource dates tags only on index.docker.io and reads OCI labels url, source and revision only, never image.created)
gcr.io/distroless/static-debian13: reproducible build with config Created 1970-01-01 and no index org.opencontainers.image.created annotation
ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/postgresql: carries the org.opencontainers.image.created annotation on 18.6-system-trixie, which Renovate 44.234.0 does not read
mcr.microsoft.com/devcontainers/base: published on mcr.microsoft.com rather than index.docker.io, so the Docker datasource assigns no release timestamp
mcr.microsoft.com/playwright: undated on mcr.microsoft.com (#411); tools/e2e/web_visual.sh locks its version to @playwright/test in the lockfile, whose npm package keeps the 3-day wait
Repeats the horistes preset rule for own images so tools/ci/image_release_age_check.py sees the coverage in renovate.json
Scoped to the exact SnatchArr image names rather than ghcr.io/lusoris/* so the preset's 3-day waits on forked images stay in force
